thumb--noun.def: The short thick finger at the side of your hand.
thumb--noun.ex: He hit his thumb with the hammer.

bald--adj.def: Having little or no hair on the head.

suspicion--noun.def: A feeling that someone has done wrong.

confusing--adj.def: Hard to understand because it is not clear.

generally--adv.def: In most cases, or by most people.

secretly--adv.def: In a way that others do not know about.

declare--verb.def: To say something officially or clearly.

ensure--verb.def: To make certain that something happens.

bubble--noun.def: A ball of air inside a liquid.

maximum--adj.def: The largest that is allowed or possible.
maximum--adj.ex: The maximum weight is ten kilos.

maximum--noun.def: The greatest amount there can be.

carriage--noun.def: A part of a train, or an old vehicle pulled by horses.
carriage--noun.ex: Our seats are in carriage six.

curtain--noun.def: Cloth hung at a window to block light.

associate--verb.def: To connect one thing with another in your mind.
associate--verb.ex: I associate that song with summer.

honesty--noun.def: The quality of telling the truth.

deed--noun.def: Something that someone does, especially notable.
deed--noun.exTr: İyi bir davranış hiçbir şeye mal olmaz.

platform--noun.def: The raised area beside a railway line, or a raised surface.
platform--noun.ex: The train leaves from platform three.

length--noun.def: How long something is from end to end.
length--noun.ex: Measure the length of the table.

tournament--noun.def: A competition with many games or rounds.

flood--verb.def: To cover a place with water.

harbor--noun.def: A sheltered place where ships stay safely.

negotiate--verb.def: To discuss in order to reach an agreement.
negotiate--verb.exTr: Daha düşük bir fiyat için pazarlık yaptılar.

collapse--noun.ex: The collapse of the roof injured two.

minimum--adj.def: The smallest that is allowed or needed.

civilization--noun.def: A developed society with its own culture.

depression--noun.def: A long period of deep sadness, or a bad economic time.
depression--noun.ex: He is receiving help for depression.

tide--noun.def: The regular rise and fall of the sea.
tide--noun.ex: The tide comes in at noon.

password--noun.def: A secret word that lets you use a system.

phrase--noun.def: A short group of words used together.

approval--noun.def: Official permission, or a good opinion.

fur--noun.def: The soft hair covering an animal's body.
fur--noun.ex: The cat's fur is very soft.

bore--verb.def: To make someone feel tired and uninterested.

fortunate--adj.def: Lucky, or happening at a good time.
fortunate--adj.ex: We were fortunate with the weather.

reply--verb.def: To answer someone in speech or writing.

disappoint--verb.def: To make someone sad because they expected better.

orbit--noun.def: The path of an object around a planet or a star.

expose--verb.def: To uncover something, or to make a secret known.

sympathy--noun.def: The feeling of being sorry for someone's trouble.
sympathy--noun.ex: She felt real sympathy for him.

growth--noun.def: An increase in size, number or importance.

encounter--noun.def: A meeting, especially an unexpected one.

accompany--verb.exTr: Kardeşi ona eve kadar eşlik etti.

sigh--noun.def: A long breath out that shows tiredness or relief.
sigh--noun.ex: She let out a deep sigh.

economic--adj.def: Relating to trade, money and industry.

exclusive--adj.def: Limited to a few people, or given to only one.

confusion--noun.def: A state of not understanding or of disorder.

brass--noun.def: A bright yellow metal made of copper and zinc.

chemistry--noun.def: The science of substances and how they change.

phoenix--noun.def: A bird in old stories that rises again from fire.
phoenix--noun.ex: The city rose like a phoenix.
phoenix--noun.exTr: Şehir anka kuşu gibi küllerinden doğdu.

companion--noun.def: A person who travels with you or keeps you company.

lottery--noun.def: A game where numbers are drawn to win money.
lottery--noun.ex: He won a small lottery prize.

tremendous--adj.def: Very great in amount or quality.

eager--adj.def: Wanting very much to do something.
eager--adj.ex: The students were eager to start.

atlantic--adj.def: Relating to the ocean between Europe and America.
atlantic--adj.ex: They sailed across the Atlantic ocean.

presentation--noun.def: A talk in which you show information to a group.

allergic--adj.def: Becoming ill when you eat or touch something.

repay--verb.def: To pay money back, or to return a kindness.

logic--noun.ex: There is no logic in that plan.

compromise--noun.def: An agreement where each side gives up something.

majority--noun.def: More than half of a group.

journal--noun.def: A serious magazine, or a daily record you write.
journal--noun.ex: The study appeared in a medical journal.

climate--noun.def: The usual weather of a region.

ink--noun.def: The coloured liquid used for writing and printing.
ink--noun.ex: The pen ran out of ink.

administration--noun.def: The work of managing an organization or a government.

resort--noun.def: A place where people go for holidays.
resort--noun.ex: The resort is busy in July.

capacity--noun.def: The amount something can hold, or the ability to do something.
capacity--noun.ex: The hall has a capacity of two hundred.

healing--adj.def: Helping a wound or an illness to get better.

survivor--noun.def: A person who lives through a dangerous event.

cough--verb.def: To push air out of your throat with a sharp sound.

pond--noun.def: A small area of still water.

runway--noun.def: The long road where planes take off and land.
runway--noun.ex: The plane waited on the runway.
